column10: SELECT SCHEDULED_TIME, COMPLETED_TIME, ERROR_MESSAGE ⏎     FROM TABLE(GN_DW.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TASK_HISTORY( ⏎            TASK_NAME => 'daily', ⏎            SCHEDULED_TIME_RANGE_START => DATEADD('day', -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), ⏎            ERROR_ONLY => TRUE)) ⏎     WHERE DATABASE_NAME = 'GN_DW' AND SCHEMA_NAME = 'OPS' ⏎       AND COMPLETED_TIME >  COALESCE(SNOWFLAKE.ALERT.LAST_SUCCESSFUL_SCHEDULED_TIME(), DATEADD('hour', -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) ⏎       AND COMPLETED_TIME <= SNOWFLAKE.ALERT.SCHEDULED_TIME()
column11: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$ ⏎   DECLARE ⏎     v_summary STRING; ⏎     v_detail  STRING; ⏎   BEGIN ⏎     SELECT 'GN_DW.OPS."daily" 실패 ' || COUNT(*) || '건 · 마지막 ' || TO_VARCHAR(MAX(COMPLETED_TIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ⏎            LEFT(LISTAGG(TO_VARCHAR(SCHEDULED_TIME, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' ' || ERROR_MESSAGE, '\n'), 4000) ⏎       INTO :v_summary, :v_detail ⏎       FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(SNOWFLAKE.ALERT.GET_CONDITION_QUERY_UUID())); ⏎     CALL GN_DW.OPS.USP_SEND_PIPELINE_ERROR_ALERT('daily', :v_summary, :v_detail, 'PIPELINE_ADMIN'); ⏎   END; ⏎   $$
